{"code": "import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Add age group for stratification
df['age_group'] = pd.cut(df['customer_age'], bins=[0, 30, 50, 100], labels=['<30', '30-50', '50+'])

# Compute conversion rates within each stratum (by customer_segment and age_group)
# We'll use stratification to compute an adjusted difference

# First, compute conversion rates by stratum and channel
stratified_rates = df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment', 'age_group'])['converted'].agg(['mean', 'count']).reset_index()
stratified_rates = stratified_rates.rename(columns={'mean': 'conversion_rate'})

# Compute overall weighted average conversion rate for each channel, weighted by stratum size
channel_stratified_rates = stratified_rates.groupby('channel')['conversion_rate'].mean().reset_index()
channel_stratified_rates = channel_stratified_rates.rename(columns={'conversion_rate': 'weighted_conversion_rate'})

# Compute the difference in weighted conversion rates
difference_weighted = channel_stratified_rates[channel_stratified_rates['channel'] == 'email']['weighted_conversion_rate'].values[0] - \
                       channel_stratified_rates[channel_stratified_rates['channel'] == 'paid_search']['weighted_conversion_rate'].values[0]

# Print results
print("Stratified conversion rates by channel and stratum:")
print(stratified_rates)
print(f"\nWeighted conversion rate (email): {channel_stratified_rates[channel_stratified_rates['channel'] == 'email']['weighted_conversion_rate'].values[0]:.4f}")
print(f"Weighted conversion rate (paid_search): {channel_stratified_rates[channel_stratified_rates['channel'] == 'paid_search']['weighted_conversion_rate'].values[0]:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference_weighted:.4f}")"}
